title: Kepler to Müller, 4 January 1630
author: Johannes Kepler
summary: Kepler hopes the type and paper are ready at Leipzig and arranges carriage to Sagan, reports what he has heard of Bartsch at Strasbourg, and settles the accounts, resolved to go on printing whatever happens.

notes.note: The seat of the Margrave of Baden, whose secretary was Bartsch's rival for Susanna's hand (see Kepler's letter of 13/23 November 1629).
